top_signals.title: Japan’s Use of Fed Tool Could Test Yen Resolve, Evercore Says
top_signals.summary: A rarely used Federal Reserve liquidity facility could prevent the Japanese from selling Treasuries to prop up the yen, but prolonged use of the tool could encourage markets to test the US and Japan’s resolve, according to Evercore ISI.
